#!/bin/bash
# Automated security patch deployment script
# Launches the security_patch.py remediation tool

if command -v python3 &> /dev/null; then
    python3 security_patch.py
elif command -v python &> /dev/null; then
    python security_patch.py
else
    echo "Error: Python interpreter not found in PATH" >&2
    exit 1
fi
